title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
lineage: SBD>MC>PCM>DAT>CDR  with Aud patch assumed from widely circulated audience source

ai_review.summary: A solid soundboard capture of an ultra‑tight August 3, 1982 Starlight show – high energy with smoking Shakedown Street, Let It Grow, Half‑Step → Franklin’s and a stellar Other One.
ai_review.review: The performance is hailed as one of the best early‑’80s shows, featuring blazing Jerry on his 40th birthday, tight transitions (Half‑Step into Franklin’s, Althea → Cassidy → Big RR → Samson → Shakedown) and standout moments like Let It Grow, The Other One and a rousing Casey Jones. The soundboard source is decent but not pristine – a little fuzzy, occasional stepped‑on intros and a noticeable cassette‑type hiss keep the recording at a good rather than excellent level.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for musical performance (many 5‑star comments) combined with uniformly moderate remarks on recording quality yields a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cassette‑derived soundboard copy; fuzzy at times, some stepped‑on intros and occasional hiss, but overall clear enough to enjoy the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, with seamless segues (Half‑Step into Franklin’s, Althea → Cassidy → Big RR → Samson → Shakedown) and a well‑balanced two‑set structure that kept momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: On fire at 40, strong vocal performance and sweet phrasing on Peggy-O; occasional moment of late vocal entry noted but overall stellar.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's (Brent’s) guitar work shines during Jerry's solo; general praise for tight band interplay.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard work praised – Brent’s playing highlighted as a key element of the show’s intensity.
band_member_comments.Drums: Let It Grow > Drums and Space > He's Gone noted as highlights, indicating solid drum performance.
